title: Open factors after base change of a product root chart
statement: Let n:N->L and phi:Spec R->L be scheme morphisms. Let f be in R, m a natural number, e:Fin m->N, and alpha:pullback n phi ~= Spec(product_k R[T]/(T^(e k)-f)) an isomorphism over Spec R. For any field K, ring map theta:R->K, and k:Fin m, there is an open immersion from Spec K[T]/(T^(e k)-theta(f)) into pullback n (Spec theta;phi), whose composite with the projection to Spec K is its canonical structural morphism. No positivity hypothesis on the exponents is necessary [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-pc-fibre-product].

source.place: Tag 0EYI, preliminary root-chart base change calculation

proof.text:
Base change alpha along Spec theta. The pullback associativity isomorphism
identifies its source with pullback n (Spec theta followed by phi). On affine rings,
tensor product commutes with finite products and polynomial quotients. The mapped
polynomial is X^(e k)-C(theta f). Each product projection is the coordinate ring
map of an open and closed factor inclusion. Compose that inclusion with the
inverse of the base-changed chart isomorphism. All maps are over Spec K, which gives
the displayed projection identity. The statement has no factors to check when m=0;
no positivity hypothesis is needed for this affine base change.

lean.statement: theorem rootProductChart_baseChange_factor {L N : Scheme.{u}} (n : N ⟶ L) (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : Spec R ⟶ L) (f : R) (m : ℕ) (e : Fin m → ℕ) (α : pullback n φ ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of (∀ k : Fin m, AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ e k - Polynomial.C f)))) (hα : α.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (∀ k : Fin m, AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ e k - Polynomial.C f)))) = pullback.snd n φ) (K : Type u) [Field K] (θ : R →+* K) (k : Fin m) : ∃ g : Spec (CommRingCat.of (AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial K) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (θ f)))) ⟶ pullback n (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom θ) ≫ φ), IsOpenImmersion g ∧ g ≫ pullback.snd n (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom θ) ≫ φ) = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial K) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (θ f)))))
